art_rules: ㅓ vs ㅣ: only when base distance <=2, extend the ㅓ arm by one pixel toward the consonant side
ㅡ vs ㅗ: only when base distance <=2, trim the shared ㅡ bar symmetrically below the ㅗ stem
ㅕ vs ㅓ: only when base distance <=2, strengthen the lower ㅕ arm by one pixel
important_correction: v0.1 broad EU trim is superseded because it could target a non-medial horizontal run depending on syllable layout. v0.2 uses counterpart-aware component location.
